build_mlp_layer: build a two-layer MLP with GELU activation and configurable hidden features for vision transformer models
create_mlp_with_dropout: create an MLP module with dropout regularization between linear layers for improved generalization
test_mlp_forward: test the Mlp forward pass by passing a tensor through fc1, activation, dropout, fc2, and dropout
refactor_mlp_activation: refactor the Mlp class to swap the default GELU activation layer with ReLU or SiLU
review_mlp_dimensions: review the Mlp class to understand how in_features, hidden_features, and out_features control layer dimensions
